findings.message: Treat / cure / heal / disease / anti-bacterial wording makes this a drug claim, which a cosmetic ad can't make.
findings.fix: Describe the cosmetic, appearance-level effect instead (e.g. 'helps reduce the look of blemishes', 'soothes the feel of dryness'). Name the ingredient and concentration rather than the condition.
